# Visual Audit

- **(1) Text legibility — FAIL:** Top-right header shows "المارجة والتقارير" — "المارجة" appears to be a broken/garbled word (likely intended "المراجعة"). Otherwise text renders fine; no clipped labels detected.

- **(2) Chart legibility — N/A/PASS:** No charts present on this page. The "اللوحات الحيّة" panel contains only icon + label menu items; these are legible with adequate contrast.

- **(3) Spacing/alignment — PASS (minor notes):** RTL layout is consistent; panels align well. Minor issue: a stray small red square marker floats oddly below the filter buttons (left area, ~y=183), looking like an orphaned bullet/decoration.

- **(4) Unstyled elements — FAIL:** The export panel is essentially empty/bare — the "تصدير التقارير (PDF/Excel)" card contains only a plain gray button ("المصدر في التطوير") with no controls, preview, or styled options; looks like a stub/placeholder rather than a finished component. The narrow sidebar icons (thin/outline style) also render inconsistently compared to the main icon set.

**Summary:** Mostly clean RTL layout; main defects = possible garbled word "المارجة", stray red marker, and an unfinished export panel.
